title: acer orientale f. rotundifolium
intro: Acer orientale f. rotundifolium, commonly known as the Oriental maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Sapindaceae family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving fever and inflammation, as well as treating respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Acer orientale f. rotundifolium include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it a useful treatment for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
